knowHow.text: Bambu PVA is a water-dissolvable support material.
Compatible with various filaments, it simplifies post-processing and reduces the risk of damaging the printed object during support removal.
Odor Odorless
Water-soluble support material
AquaSolve™ PVA has a limited smell during printing and is non-toxic and biodegradable once dissolved in water.

AquaSolve™ PVA is a rapidly cold water soluble PolyVinyl Alcohol type of filament, which bonds extremely well to (thermo)plastics and because of its process stability is “easy to print” at relatively low temperatures.
PVA is a water-soluble material that is often used as a support material with no need of adding any chemical and speicial treating.
Leave the part in a warm water bath dissolve faster.

After dissolution, there is no residue on the model surface with smoothy effect; it can be worked with PLA, TPU, PA(nylon) and other consumables materials to print extremely complex shapes or support materials with a partially closed cavity model.
It is recommended to work with eBOX(3D filament dryer) in printing.
It is recommended to set the distance between the support and the model to 0, Slow down and turn off the fan for the first layer to bond well with the main material.

Helios Support is a “high heat” water-soluble PVA material which is engineered as support material for dual extrusion 3D printing in combination with engineering materials which require to be printed at higher temperatures and/or in heated build chambers.

Helios support can be printed at nozzle temperatures up to 250° C without the risk of cross linking and nozzle clogging and adheres extremely well to styrene based materials such as ABS, TitanX, Crystal Flex, and ApolloX, but also to Python Flex and Volcano PLA.
Helios Support dissolves slightly slower in water than normal PVA, but the dissolving process can be sped up when using warm and circulating water.
PVA offers excellent dimensional stability, no warping or cracking and is easy to print.
Water-soluble/Easy to print/Dimensional stability
It is commonly used as a support material in 3D printing due to its water-soluble nature.
Biodegradable when dissolved in water
more difficult to process than other soluble support materials - short residence times until decomposition
PVA is very sensitive to moisture and should always be stored in closed bags.
PVA is a polyvinyl alcohol that dissolves easily in cold water.
It combines well with other plastics such as PLA, ABS or PETG and is therefore ideal as a support material in dual extrusion printing.
Support structures detach from the printed object within 24 hours without leaving any residue.
Raise3D Premium PVA+ is a polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) based cold water soluble support filament for dual extruder FFF 3D printing.
The material has enhanced thermal stability, and compatible with generic materials including PLA, PETG, PA (Nylon), etc.
Ease of removal with smooth support interface;
The printing temperature should not exceed 225˚C for over 5 min.
Once unpacked, please ensure the material is properly dried before print, in order to avoid any printing issue.
The dissolution rate of Raise3D Premium PVA+ in water is dependent on the volume of the printed object, the amount and temperature of water.
Using higher water temperature (up to 70˚C) will accelerate the dissolution process.

However, to prevent the part deformation during dissolution process, the water temperature should not exceed the softening temperature of main material used, especially for PLA (water temperature lower than 60 ˚C).
Raise3D Premium PVA+ works with most of the common part bed adhesives.
Atlas Support™ is an unique PVA blend which has a far more improved thermal stability compared to "normal" PVA and by that ensures a much more stable dual extrusion printing process.
Atlas Support™ is much less sensitive to degradation by humidity.
Atlas Support™ is the next generation in water-soluble support materials for dual extrusion FDM 3D printing.
Atlas Support™ bonds extremely well to a wide variety of thermoplastics such as PLA, ABS, HIPS, TPE, TPU.
Though it is possible to use PolyDissolve™ S1 with a single nozzle, it is not recommended due to increase chances of clogging when swapping materials.
PolyDissolve™ S1 is a very hygroscopic material, meaning it absorbs moisture very easily.
You should use a heated filament dryer on the lowest setting for the entirety of your print.
If you hear any "popping" or "cracking", or you see the filament bubbling up when extruded, you need to dry the material.
PolyDissolve™ S1 is a PVA-based filament engineered to provide water-soluble support for PLA, TPU, PVB, and Nylon-based filaments.
It forms a perfect interface with these materials, offering strong support during printing and dissolving cleanly in water for easy post-processing.

Specifically designed for use with Polymaker’s PLA, TPU, PVB, and Nylon filaments, PolyDissolve™ S1 displays excellent solubility and is ideal for intricate prints with complex overhangs and internal structures.
Supports typically dissolve in 6–12 hours.
Dissolution can be sped up by increasing water temperature, changing water regularly, or adding water movement.
IDEX or ToolChanger is recommended.
You need to print PolyDissolve™ S1 very slowly - we recommend no higher than 60mm/s or 8mm^3/s max volumetric speed.
It is possible to print a material and PolyDissolve out of a single nozzle but you need to make sure you properly purge all of the previous material when swapping.
PVA has excellent solubility in water, making PolyDissolve™ S1 a very good dissolvable support material for FFF 3d printing.

PolyDissolve™ S1 can be used as full support material or only as the interface between the support structure and the model, this later can allow the support to be easily removable by hand but will also speed up the dissolving process.
PolyDissolve™ S1 is designed to be partially removable by hand so we recommend to remove the support that can be easily pealed off before submerging the model into water.
After partially removing the support the model can be submerged in water to dissolve away the rest of the support.
This process can be speed up by agitating the water, using warm water (>50˚C) or regularly changing the water.
It is specifically engineered to have a perfect interface with these materials while also displaying good solubility.
PolyDissolve™ S1 is a water dissolvable support for PLA, TPU, PVB and Nylon based filaments from our portfolio.
Atlas Support is a water-soluble PVA type of 3D printer filament that is ideal as support material for complex multi-extrusion 3D printing with PETG based filaments as build material.

polymerEnvironment.finding: PVOH are water-soluble polymers manufactured by alcoholysis of polyvinyl acetate. The properties of the various grades are mainly governed by the molecular weight and the remaining content of the acetyl groups.
polymerEnvironment.notes: KURARAY POVAL LM grades (40-50 mol% hydrolysis) are not fully water soluble but disperse in water; storage note p. 11: keep dry and prevent contact with rain or water.

polymerEnvironment.conditions: Cold water; agitated water tank at about 30-40 °C recommended
polymerEnvironment.finding: MOWIFLEX 3D 2000 is soluble in cold water, which makes it inherently sensitive to moisture... To dissolve the support structures in water it is recommended to use an agitated water tank at slightly elevated temperatures (ca. 30-40 °C). MOWIFLEX 3D 2000 will also dissolve at room temperature and without agitation, but dissolving will take much longer.
polymerEnvironment.notes: MOWIFLEX 3D 2000 is a Kuraray polyvinyl alcohol support filament; recorded under PVA because its TDS names polyvinyl alcohol as its base.

polymerEnvironment.finding: KURARAY POVAL possesses remarkable barrier properties due to its insolubility in most organic solvents.
Surfaces treated with KURARAY POVAL repel hydrophobic materials such as oil, grease, and fat.
